meta.themes: Cybersecurity Models Advance, Enterprise Agents Reach Production, AI Capital Consolidates, Infrastructure Expands With New Controls

news.title: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber for authorized vulnerability research
news.summary: OpenAI said GPT-6 Cyber improved 51% over GPT-5.6 Cyber on ExploitGym while adding stronger controls to keep security agents within researcher-defined scope.

news.title: Google launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with longer video and lower pricing
news.summary: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available with native 15-second video, multi-turn editing, stronger reference adherence, and pricing 30% below Omni 1.1.

news.title: Mistral expanded Studio for enterprise agents, workflows, and apps
news.summary: Mistral added managed agents and apps plus workflow, context, observability, and evaluation features to Studio, with cloud, VPC, and on-premises deployment options.

news.title: Aramco took a 49% stake in Saudi AI company HUMAIN
news.summary: Aramco contributed about $2.6 billion in cash plus AI and compute assets for 49% of HUMAIN, which plans to deploy 3 gigawatts of data center capacity by 2030.

news.title: OpenAI agreed to acquire Pierre Computer Company
news.summary: OpenAI said Pierre's code storage, tree navigation, and diff-review technology will expand Codex tools for Git workflows used by developers and coding agents.

news.title: Five9 agreed to acquire Level AI for about $325 million
news.summary: Five9 said the acquisition will bring Level AI's customer-experience agents and conversation intelligence to more than 4,000 customers as integrated or standalone products.

news.title: Google committed $15 billion to expand digital infrastructure in Malaysia
news.summary: Google plans new data center campuses, a Malaysian cloud region, workforce programs, and more than 1 gigawatt of clean energy capacity through a 2027-2028 investment.

news.title: SageMaker added managed GPU partitioning for inference endpoints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU partitions so teams can isolate and right-size multiple models on one accelerator without managing Kubernetes.

news.title: The U.S. Justice Department formed a Super Intelligence Task Force
news.summary: The DOJ created a task force to coordinate enforcement against unlawful super-intelligence use, harden risk reporting, and press companies for strong internal controls.

news.title: Cursor started turning cloud-agent prompts into hosted live apps
news.summary: Cursor's Build Live Apps can scaffold code, provision Postgres and sign-in, run security checks, and deploy a shareable application from a cloud-agent request.

news.title: Amazon Quick added bounded automatic approvals for agent actions
news.summary: Smart Approvals reviews eligible agent actions against the user's request while preserving policy denials, mandatory human review, single-use authorization, and audit evidence.

news.title: Grok Bot 1.0 added proactive and shared AI teammates
news.summary: Grok Bot 1.0 introduced team-shared bots that can work in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and meetings, monitor ongoing work, coordinate tasks, and request judgment for sensitive actions.
